brief.name: Brief example traveller
brief.description: The example request from the project brief: EUR 50 budget, morning departure, at most 1 transfer, changeable ticket required.

budget.name: Budget traveller
budget.description: Cost matters most and the traveller will accept a slow journey with a connection, but not more than two transfers.

business.name: Business traveller
business.description: Time is money: short direct journeys leaving early, with a ticket that can be changed. Must arrive within the day.

tourist.name: Flexibility-focused tourist
tourist.description: Plans may change, so the ticket must be changeable and refundable fares are rewarded strongly; rating and a 20 kg luggage allowance also count.

eco.name: Environment-focused traveller
eco.description: Wants the lowest emissions and fewer transfers; will pay somewhat more.
